beats: Walk from the harbour approach into the public exhibition hall.
Read or inspect the sabre display and the ordinary coastal collections.
data.consequences: Inspection completes the visit; the blade remains behind glass. The visit is optional and does not gate the captain’s invitation.

description:
A first museum visit places a strange blade among ordinary coastal objects and makes incomplete historical knowledge visible.

Unknown maker and incomplete provenance are honest limits, not license for an attendant to reveal the final plot.
name: The blade behind glass
